concept.core_mechanic: one-touch lane switching timed to a beat
concept.fantasy: being effortlessly in the groove — the player feels skilled before they are
concept.core_loop: anticipate the beat, tap to switch lanes, extend a combo, push for a personal best, retry immediately

monetization_hypothesis.rationale: Failure-and-retry loops create a natural rewarded moment: continue the run rather than lose the combo.

risks.description: Audio latency on mobile web can break beat-matching, which is the entire mechanic.
Russian localization is mandatory on Yandex and machine translation is rejected.
